audited_repository_state.scope_note: The release endpoint identifies this commit in production. The audit is source-contract analysis; no mandate, wallet, payment, or settlement operation was invoked.

cryptographic_executor_proof.finding: Caller proof binds Ed25519 did:key or Base-EOA control to the exact method, resource, body hash, expiry and nonce, but does not distinguish autonomous code from a human signer and does not name a separate executor under a principal.

principal_authorization.finding: AGSM-1 owner-authenticates a Base EOA, persists cumulative authority and owner-only exact-payment authorization. It does not yet express distinct principal-to-executor delegation or hash-link the owner caller proof into the portable authorization credential.

per_request_ceiling.finding: AGSM-1 atomically enforces total, per-counterparty and count caps; the official payment policy checks the selected x402 amount before signing. Bare x402 still proves quote equality rather than buyer policy.

exact_quote_resource_binding.finding: Signed offers and settlement validation bind method, canonical resource, scheme, network, asset, recipient, amount, expiry and payment tuple.

liability_routing.finding: No declared liability party or URI is carried by AGSM, caller proof, signed x402 offer, receipt or evidence. The self-attested agent principal field is not a substitute.

expiry_and_replay.finding: Caller proof, signed offer, EIP payment window, mandate window and short authorization credential are all time-bounded; nonces and exact bodies are replay-protected.

receipt_and_result_hash.finding: AG-served x402 responses produce signed receipts plus exact request and response hashes. Neither receipt nor evidence currently contains the mandate, authorization or caller-proof digests.

prepayment_input_validation.finding: AG normalizes and validates protected-route inputs before charging, but the generic nested Bazaar schema remains broad and AGSM cannot validate arbitrary external merchant semantics.

decision.accepted_direction: Add one optional io.agent-guild/spend-accountability extension on top of AGSM-1 rather than inventing a second mandate protocol.
minimum_join: declared liability URI labelled as unverified metadata
existing transaction, request and result hashes
decision.enforcement: When present, verify the executor and every authority digest before facilitator settlement, then echo the same join into the existing signed evidence. Absence must preserve ordinary x402 interoperability.
decision.reason: Most machine requirements already exist. The remaining change crosses mandate, caller-proof, x402 payload and receipt evidence contracts, so it needs an isolated current-main implementation and executable interop/replay/tamper tests rather than an in-place patch on the stale primary checkout.
